newsitem.title: FINLAND: Kemira says Goldman uses greenshoe option.
newsitem.headline: Kemira says Goldman uses greenshoe option.

text.p: Finnish chemicals and fertiliser group Kemira Oy said in a statement on Thursday lead manager Goldman Sachs would exercise its greenshoe option to subscribe three million extra Kemira shares.
"Kemira will issue the new shares around November 13 1996. The company will get 144,045,000 markka in new capital for the extra shares issued," it said.

In total, Kemira will then have issued eight million new shares to international institutional investors and the government will have sold all the 18 million shares it offered to institutions and the public, Kemira said.
"After the issue to institutions and offering to private investors, the Finnish state's stake of Kemira's share capital is 53.8 percent, having been 72.3 percent before the offerings," it said.
The shares were placed at 49.50 markka. Kemira was untraded early on Thursday after closing at 50.70 markka on Wednesday.
